title: 1D Controller [A(v),B(v),C(v),D(v)]
text: Implement gain-scheduled state-space controller depending on one scheduling parameter, 2 inputs, 1 output; {A-matrix(v)} sets a matrix of the state-space implementation, {B-matrix(v)} sets the b matrix of the state-space implementation, {C-matrix(v)} sets the c matrix of the state-space implementation, {D-matrix(v)} sets the d D1, {Scheduling variable breakpoints} sets the breakpoints for scheduling and {Initial state, x_initial} sets the initial states. Values come from the instance.

params.name: A-matrix(v)
params.values: A matrix of the state-space implementation A1 (default) | array

params.name: B-matrix(v)
params.values: B matrix of the state-space implementation B1 (default) | array

params.name: C-matrix(v)
params.values: C matrix of the state-space implementation C1 (default) | array

params.name: Scheduling variable breakpoints
params.values: Breakpoints for scheduling variable v_vec (default) | vector
